specs.title: F01 first visit: empty state, nothing stored before the user acts
F02 first form from the empty state opens the editor and is stored
F03 second form, listing (newest first, counts, date) and "Düzenle" opens the right form
F04 title and description: live preview, list card and storage
F05 duplicate: "(kopya)", "(kopya 2)", fields copied and independent of the original
F06 delete form: Vazgeç, Escape and backdrop cancel; "Formu sil" deletes and survives reload
F07 every field type: defaults, preview control, unique JSON names
F08 placeholder and help text reach the preview; hidden where they do not apply
F09 required: marker in list and preview, aria-required, checkbox message
F10 rules: invalid e-mail, number range, text length, date range, select choice
F11 empty required submit, live re-validation, "Temizle" resets
F12 live preview follows label, type, options and order changes
F13 delete field: cancel keeps it; confirm removes it from list, preview and storage
F14 reorder with ↑/↓: list, preview, storage and export follow; edge buttons are disabled
F15 export: JSON content, real download, clipboard, warnings, three ways to close, focus return
F16 persistence: real reload in the editor keeps every setting; browser back/forward work
F17 broken storage: corrupt JSON, wrong shape, partly invalid data, unknown form link
F18 storage full / blocked: warning banner instead of silent data loss
F19 keyboard: create, add a field and delete via dialog without a mouse; Escape and focus order
F20 BUG-003 regression: skip link moves focus to the content and does not leave the editor
F21 BUG-001 regression: two tabs never overwrite each other's forms
F22 BUG-002 regression: "Temiz başlat" never deletes forms created after the warning
F24 BUG-004 regression: one click on "Gönder (test)" submits even when the last field turns invalid on blur
F25 JSON name: auto-sync with the label until edited by hand; invalid and duplicate names are flagged
F23 network: the app loads without login and sends no form data anywhere
F26 BUG-005 regression: unparsable number input is rejected, optional or required; "Temizle" clears it
F27 BUG-006 regression: options are trimmed, de-duplicated and identical in storage, preview, validation and export
F28 BUG-007 regression: preview errors follow schema changes (required on/off)
F29 BUG-008 regression: export file names keep Turkish letters correctly (İ ı Ş ş Ğ ğ Ü ü Ö ö Ç ç)
F30 BUG-009 regression: Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside both modals; focus returns to a sensible trigger
F31 BUG-010 regression: an empty title or label still gives every button a meaningful accessible name
